title: Total dry biomass by animal group (megatons of carbon)

source.name: The abundance, biomass, and distribution of ants on Earth
source.publisher: Schultheiss et al., Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS), 2022

notes: Ant total dry biomass (~12 Mt carbon) from Schultheiss et al. 2022 (synthesis of 489 studies). Wild mammal and wild bird biomass (excluding humans and livestock) from Bar-On, Phillips & Milo, 'The biomass distribution on Earth', PNAS 2018 (wild mammals ~0.007 Gt C = 7 Mt C; wild birds ~0.002 Gt C = 2 Mt C).
